sanskrit: lokeśaḥ karaṇāni yasya mahimā taṃ netranāthaṃ stumaḥnetraṃ pañcakasaptakātma śivayornauṃmyekavīraṃ mṛḍambodhollāso jayati sa guruḥ ko'pyapūrvo rahasyaḥśaivaṃ netramanugrahāya jagato'mutraiduddyotaterasayata sarasāḥ parimalamasārasaṃsāravāsanāśāntyaipṛṣṭavatīprārthaye, etanniḥśeṣaṃ me prapannāyā vaktumarhasivaktraṃ yasyapāṭhe spaṣṭo'rthaḥnirṇītatattvaṃ tat śṛṇomi adhijigamiṣāmijātaḥ, ityetadviruddhamābhāsamānaṃ samarthayasva parameśvaretiṣoḍhā saṃbandhaḥ prasiddha evatādṛg anuttamamucyatevābhāviduḥkhāsparśāt sarvaduḥkhavimokṣadamityādianena caikaviṃśādhikārabhāvisṛṣṭyādyupakṣiptamjīvānāṃ parametatsantāraṇamviśeṣānukteḥ sarvaṃ mahāvīryarūpatvātbhedānantyena nānāvaicitryeṇa prasṛtammahyamiti madartham, spaṣṭaṃ śiṣṭamyāvatte prathamo'dhikāraḥsuṣṭhu pīḍitāḥ sarve mucyante nivṛttasarvopadravā apavṛjyantebhagavato'sādhyamiti smitaṃ vidhāya
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśeṣataḥ pratijānīte, atyantopādeyatvādasyārthasyaetadadhikārapratijñādarśayiṣyāmaḥmātā mātṛkā aśeṣamantrādijananīproddharediti pūjānantaramityarthaḥpadārthajātasyaikapraṇavātmatā darśitāiti śrīpūrve'bhidhānādardhacatasraḥ koṭayo'dhikṛtāḥtadaṅkuśordhvavinyastaṃ tiryaggāntordhvayojitambindurardhacandrādiprameyāsūtraṇaparaḥsaṅgatirdarśitāprabhañjanāntaśirasaṃ hṛdayaṃ sarvasiddhidamsiddhīrdadātipāramparyeṇaśivaśaktyetyanenordhvagasarvamāntraprameyamuktam, varma kavacamsarvapāpadāhī | cakāraḥ paraviśrāntipradatvaṃ samuccinotianenādhikārāntarasaṅgatiḥ sūciteti śivammantroddhāro dvitīyo'dhikāraḥmṛdamuddhṛtya snānamārabheteti saṅgatiḥ.........ṣaptabhiḥ śuddhyate punaḥtadadṛṣṭau prāṇārkaspṛṣṭām, nijavivakṣitaṃ caitadanulepanamsavyāpasavyagatāntarpaṇaṃ kuryātsvātmalīnaṃ kṛtvā, yāgagṛhaṃ bhāvividhinā viśetvaicitryamutpādayituṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ kuryātdagdhaṃ bhāvayet
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatra dehe cintite jñeyaśūnyatvād vyāpi cinmātraṃ smaretsanmanaḥ samarasīgataṃ cinmātrarūpaṃ jātamevaradābhayāmṛtakalaśapūrṇendukaratāupacaryate'nenetyupacāraḥ kusumanaivedyādiutpannaṃ samullasitamamṛtaṃ paraṃ śāktaṃ vīryamkṛpālutvātmānasaistattatsiddhyucitaiḥiti pratyabhijñoktanītyā tritvena vibhaktamityarthaḥsudhūpitaṃ kṛtvā ityarthaḥ | anyat spaṣṭammiśraiḥ sitalohitācchādirūpaiḥyasyāstāmcastvarthe | ayute daśasāhasrehastamānānusārocitamekhalādimānamdehoccāṭanādikarmabhedena | śiṣṭamiti trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇādirūpamgomayotpuṃsanamkuryāttritattva iti praṇava ihatyo mūlamantro vāprokṣaṇatāḍanakuṇḍalyātmakakuṇḍakalpanāni kuryātśivāgnistadāpādanam | tridhā bhramaṇaṃ ca praṇavenaivayadatra tattvaṃ tat śrīsvacchandoddyote darśitampūjātmasaṃskāramukhāvirbhāvisaṃskārān kuryātsamānatantrāpekṣatvāt | evamuttaratrāpisarvasaṃskārān vahnau karomi svāhā" ityatrohaḥvidhānamanantaraṃ bhaviṣyati | kṣīravṛkṣaḥ śvetārkādiḥśrīparṇībilvādyutthau
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulamānateti viśeṣaḥpīṭhamānaṃ bhavatidvyaṅgulīkāryamityarthaḥ | samutsedha aunnatyamvartulaṃ bhavatipatrāvalyādi | suracitamiti tu spaṣṭammadhyamatribhāgamānaḥ kārya ityarthaḥmukhāgramaṣṭāṅgulamānāttribhāgaṃ bhavatimadhyenājyadhārāpātāyasaṃskārau noktauamṛtamudrātra pradarśyāhutena sādhakasyasarvān kāmānavāpnoti satyameva na cānyathāspaṣṭamīhitaṃ kāmamuddiśya īhitaṃ homamācaretpayasā kevalenaiva homānmṛtyuṃ jayed dhruvamnetrodyote yajanādistṛtīyo'dhikāraḥparāparavibhūtirmokṣabhogau saṃpādyau sarvatrāviśiṣṭaudīkṣākramasyāvirodhātevaṃ hyanālasyanaiḥspṛhyābhyāṃ daiśikānāmuttamatākuryātputrakāṇāṃ paratattva eva, samayināmīśvaratattva iti vibhāgāḥdīkṣādhikāraścaturthaḥsāracintanena saha śirasi kalaśāmbhaḥkṣepātmakamkhyānaṃ tanmayatayā prathā yeṣāmatrāpi śrīsvacchandādyuktā sarvā prakriyānusaraṇīyā
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: spaṣṭamanyatsāmānyakarmāṇi vaśyākarṣaṇādīninetrodyote'bhiṣekavidhirnāma pañcamo'dhikāraḥdaurgatyādiharamyattat saṃpravakṣyāmipūrvoktāḥsarvātmakaṃ paramādvayam | etaccāṣṭamādhikāre nirṇeṣyateyāgādiniścayasyaiva siddhinimittatvātspaṣṭamyasya nāmnā tasyetyarthātsamidhaḥmantrarājaprasādātsvacchandoktanītyā sarvatrātra vaṣaṭjātiḥ prayojyāmūlamantreṇetyarthātjapo'tra svakalpoktavidhināprayuktamityarthaḥmṛtyumuttarati | kṛtveti antarbhāvitaṇijartho'pijīvaddehasyāyaṃ rodhanaprayogaḥsaptāhaṃ madhumadhye nihitaṃ ca mṛtyujitsādhyaśarīraṃ svasthatāmetiprakṛṣṭā bhuktimuktilakṣaṇā siddhirarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasyaetatkalaśābhiṣekāt sarvo'bhīṣṭaphalamāpnotītyarthaḥśāstrāntaravyavahāreṇaevaṃ sthūlaṃ vidhānaṃ tu sūkṣmaṃ caivādhunā śṛṇu
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti śivamnetrodyote sādhanavidhiḥ ṣaṣṭho'dhikāraḥsūkṣmadhyānāmṛtonmiṣacchāktamūrtirbhavatikāryaḥunmanāparatattvātmani dhāmnisadāśivaṃ tathā śaktiṃ śivasthānaṃ prabhedayetvijñānenordhvaṃ dvādaśāntaṃ yāvadvisaret prasarettadbhavanti tanmayā jāyanta ityarthaḥśatulyo bhavatina kasyacinmayākhyātaṃ tvadṛte bhaktavatsaletavaiva parānugrahaikavratāyā evaṃ prakaṭīkṛtamnetrodyote sūkṣmadhyānanirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptamo'dhikāraḥmāyāntasadāśivāntaśivāntabhavābhavātibhavarūpespaṣṭambhavatītyarthaḥbhavapāśānāṃ nikṛntakaḥdhyānaṃ viduravicchinnena pāramparyeṇa jānanti | ca evārtheparaḥ samādhiḥ smṛtaḥ pāramparyataḥ prasiddhaḥnityoditatvenāvyutthānaṃ samādhānamtatsamādhānaṃ vidustattvajñāḥdṛṣṭvā sākṣātkṛtya, na purjanmaiticaitanyamātmano rūpaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu kathyate"caitanyamātmā" iti prārambha evoktamdhyeyamityanugrāhakatvena buddhyopasthāpitamityānandapadasaṃlīnasamarasajñānamayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sāṃsārikī sthitimujjhatitasyā yadbalaṃ vimarśadāḍharyaṃ tena bhāvayetyogīatratya ityarthaḥcoktyānāśvastānāmapyāśvāsaṃ rohayatiiti sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ priyeśivamnetrodyote aṣṭamo'dhikāraḥiti | cintāratnādiva phalodayo yataḥsiddhāntavāmadakṣiṇādiśāstroktaṃ phalaṃ pradadātitadicchāvagrāhitatatphalābhiniveśatayābhāvanurūpeṇāśayānuguṇena | bhāvena bhāvanāprakāreṇasadāśivatanurbhavati sādāśivīmiva mūrtimanugrahāyāśrayatispheṭakamudyamanakamvidhiḥ siddhāntoktaḥ prakāraḥprapūjayetnetrodyote navamo'dhikāraḥsiddhānteṣvapi niṣkalasvatantrapārameśavyāpterbhāvātathavā himakundendumuktāphalasamadyutimityādi | yathānurūpaṃ dhyānānusārisūryakoṭisamaprakhyāṃ jvalitāgnisamaprabhāmdigambarāmiti gajacarmottarīyāmityetadapekṣo'yamarthādvikalpaḥparivāro mūlamantreṇa pūjya iti bhāvirakṣāvidherjñātamrocanākuṅkumenaiva kṣīreṇa sitayā tathā| naivedyairyo balistena sahitairāsavairiti saṃbandhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: netrodyote daśamo'dhikāraḥuttamatvamasya parādvayasāraitanmantravyāptiyuktyaivamūlenaivakandaṃ kapālamkaradvayenopalakṣitāiti tatraivābhidhānādevaṃrūpaḥ cintyaḥvaśyādivaicitryeṇamahābalaṃ śāntyādāvapratihatammantracakratṛptyarthamityarthāt | pūrvavaditi vartula ityarthaḥatra jagati | jayati īhitāptyā sarvotkarṣeṇa vartata iti śivamnetrodyote ekādaśo'dhikāraḥkulāmnāyanidarśanam | yāgaṃ homaṃ japaṃ kāryaṃ yena sarvamavāpnuyātkulāmnāyadarśanaśabdārthaḥvāmo varadaḥmahāsaṃbhāreṇetyarthaḥityarthaḥsṛṣṭyunmukhaṃ saṃpādayantiityādi śrīsvacchandoktamanusartavyamiti śivamnetrodyote dvādaśo'dhikāraḥihatyavyāptyā pūrṇabhogāpavargadamihatyamantravimṛśyamānamityarthātaṅgānāṃ vinyāsaḥ prāgvatkarpūrī candanī caiva kastūrī kuṅkumī tathāanekavaktrasaṃghātairanekāstrabhujaistathāavyakta ityetadākhyaḥ, sa ca niṣkalaḥ suśāntasvarūpaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mṛtyujiddhāmetyarthātsūryaṃ dhyāyetathavāṣṭabhujaṃ devi lokapālāyudhānvitamcandrādiṣaṭkaṃ keturāhū ceti grahāḥ | dvitīyake ityāvaraṇesaṃdaṃśamiti bibhratamvṛṣārūḍhaṃ caturbhujamiti sadāśivarūpādviśeṣaḥprāgvatnetrodyote trayodaśo'dhikāraḥniścitaṃ sat paraṃ rahasyamiti sthityānaupamyādirūpam | śiṣṭaṃ prāgeva vyākṛtaprāyamśobhanā siddhirmuktiparyavasānā bhuktiḥnetrodyote caturdaśo'dhikāraḥupalakṣaṇaṃ caitatpuṣpādeḥevaṃ varṇabhedāśrayaḥ karmabhedaḥ purākalpe'bhūtsito lohitaśceti dvirūpo'dya tu uttamatvānna pracaratītyarthaḥkurvantītyarthaḥdakṣiṇayā toṣitaḥ | phalaṃ muktisiddhī, evamuttaratranamaskāraśca devānāṃ vauṣaṭ śāntau praśasyatesvadheti svadhāśabdaḥ | spaṣṭamanyatnetrodyote pañcadaśo'dhikāraḥkūṭānāmanye sāmānyato devi na siddhyanti kadācanayāvat sādhakasyecchayā ceṣṭaḥ siddhido bhavati dhruvamdīkṣākāle tu kartavyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ yatra tatra higṛhe vā parvatāgrādau vā
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hiṃsāparā dṛśyante, tataḥ suguptataiva yuktāspaṣṭamanyattatheti suguptyā niḥsaṃśayatayā caityarthaḥnityādiṣusāmānyena viśeṣeṇa kaulikenātha suvratesiddhidaḥtrāṇakṛt śivarūpaḥvāśabda uttarapakṣadāḍhryetenaiveti paramaśivatayā'parijñātenadehādimayatvādbhārabhūtaḥnānāsaṃniveśamātrakalpakaḥ, na tu vyāptijñaḥtatra tatra śāstrebhinnābhāsatvamivaśivaśaktyoḥ, tatra viśāradastatsamāveśamayaḥparameśamukhaṃ parā śaktiḥśāntikādīni karmāṇi viṣabhūtagrahādiṣusadyaḥ pratyayetyarthaḥkarmaṇā bhogasaktasya abhilāṣānvitasya caśaktimatsvarūpāyattatvāt śakteḥpūrvaślokārthaḥbhagavatpūjārthamārabhetaāpado naśyantitasya śāntirbhavet kṣipraṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇāācāryakṛtena sādhyasya
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhyasya mantreṇa rakṣyasya ātmanaḥ parasya vetyarthaḥcakratraye dalapuñjatraye | sādhyārṇarodhanaṃ prāgvatjīvaḥ sakāraḥ, tadantaḥkṛtanāmakamsaṃbhṛtaiḥ saṃbhāraiḥpraṇavasvanāmanamobhiḥtattvajñagurupūjā sādhayatyabhīṣṭamiti śivamnetrodyote ṣoḍaśo'dhikāraḥpararāṣṭravibhītānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ vijayāvahamrakṣā hyeṣā prakartavyā sarvopadravanāśinīspaṣṭampūjājapahomādibhirārādhayetśāntikarmaṇyavasthito guruḥ sāvadhānaḥ syādityarthaḥvauṣaḍantamantrarājakṛtāpyāyanamkalaśenetyapapāṭhaḥvajreṇa caturaśraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhye nyasyetpūrvavat padmamālikhya ṣaḍaṅgaṃ pūrvavat priyenetrodyote saptadaśo'dhikāraḥsiddhikāraṇāni teṣāṃ sādhanamātmāyattatāpādanaṃ jānātiviniyojanaṃ tena sādhakeśvarāḥ siddhyanti āpnuvanti abhīṣṭamudayāstamayau vyāptiṃ dhyānaṃ mudrāṃ svarūpataḥevamanyairaśeṣaiśca bhāvabhedaiḥ sureśvaribhāgyāvahamimamtiśabdalopa eśaḥ | endravāruṇe iti pūrvāparāyatānītyarthaḥsusamatvaṃ bhramāṇāṃ svātmani, samāṃśatvaṃ tu parasparamdātavyā, ante bahirbhāge pītalā haritālādiyojitā
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvataḥ sarvāsu dikṣu | vīthī pūjāpradeśamārgaḥvyāptiṃ yāgasya prakāśayitumkārayetvibhāga utpadyatebhūtasaṃkhyākāḥ pañcetyarthaḥpūrvadine'dhivāsaḥ kartavya ityarthaḥdhvajāni citracihnānipañcaraṅgāṇīti sūtrāṇikāryaumṛtyujit pārameśvaraṃ rūpamśaktiṃ tarpayediti saṅgatiḥśrīsvacchande'sticaivaiśvarīṃ śubhāmpaṭe tu likhitā devī yasya veśmani pūjyateagre prārambhedevyāḥ prasādato jayamāpnotīti saṃbandhaḥso'bhīṣṭamāpnotītyarthaḥvipaścitā vyāptijñena | sarvakāmāṃśceti cakārād muktimḍāvyo ḍāmarikā devyo bhaginyo dūtayastathābhāvabhedānusārāsāditasvocitasiddhayaḥsarvabhuktimuktipradetyarthaḥśrīmadamṛteśaikaviṣayaḥprāgavasthāpekṣā uktiḥśivaikyamiyātkṛśasthūlam
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ativitatakālaṃ bhogalakṣmīmāsādayatīti śivamnetrodyote aṣṭādaśo'dhikāraḥcakārād dṛṣṭipātādeḥbhūtāśca vividhākārā hyanantāśca mahābalāḥchāyādidoṣaiḥpaśūpahārayuktyaiva bhagavadarcāniṣṭhāḥbhavantīti śeṣaḥanuktairiti brahmahananādibhiḥ, anyairiti mitradrohādibhiḥtayā anugamaḥ saṃbandhaḥlabdhacchidrā hītyarthāntaranyāsaḥtatkṣaṇaṃ na vilambeta svalpenaiva kṛtena hitadeti tata ityarthaḥ | samācarediti pratīkārampañcagavyena vā tatra mantrayuktena kārayetbhavediti śeṣaḥityādinā granthenakṛtsno mātṛsamūhastu tuṣṭo bhavati tatkṣaṇātsitaraktapītakṛṣṇaiḥ puṣpairnānāvidhaistathābhūrimadyaistathā māṃsai raktapuṣpavilepanaiḥtena tena mantreṇātratyenaivaiti kriyākālaguṇottare lakṣitāḥ | rakṣodhipo nirṛtiḥdevatāyoginībhūtādibhyaḥiti tatraivoktam | pūrvoktavidhiriha mantreṇa arcāhomādimahānavamyāmevasamāsaḥ, saṅgho mātṛyoginyādigaṇaḥbhūrihomeneti sahārthe tṛtīyā
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arśāṃsi cakṣūrogāśca tathā visarpakādayaḥābhyantarā vyādhayaśca śokādyāścittanāśakāḥtadā tu pūrvavadyāgaḥ kartavyaḥ śāntihetaveasyāstijñatvakartṛtvaśūnyaḥprāpitasaṃsārabhāvasyabhogādāvityādigrahaṇāt sāṃkhyādidṛṣṭe tāttvike pakṣe'pitriṃśattattvātma māyākāryaṃ māyākhyaṃ malamkośakāraḥ krimiryadvadātmānaṃ veṣṭayed dṛḍhamsaugatamīmāṃsakasāṃkhyādibhiriṣyatesarveṣāmanugrāhako'saugrāhyagrāhakādikāluṣyollāsikā'parārūpāco hyarthe | dānaṃ śivatvābhivyakteḥ, kṣapaṇaṃ tu pāśānāmvyāpakasyāṇoḥ svarūpaprakāśanātkriyāśaktirūpā maheśvarīti prabhaviṣṇuḥ rakṣā uktāiti lakṣaṇamuktam | durādharṣā balino duḥsahāścaśivaśaktiprabhāvastadājñāvaśavartitārakṣā kriyate, sā sukṛtā syātsamyak pravakṣyāmi vyākhyāsyāmiyadā strī mudritā bhūtaistadā garbho na saṃbhavetasminniti retoraktātmani | bījasaṃbhavo garbhādhānamkāryamiti, sūtikāgṛhamityarthāttamapi bhūtā hiṃsanti, tasmād rakṣetkṣīrasparśādipoṣaṇaiḥśriyo bhogamokṣavitaraṇaruco jīvanaṃ vācyarūpaṃ caitanyam
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na bhavanti ceti bāhulyena na bhavantītyarthaḥ| araha iti eśaḥ pāṭha iti śivamnetrodyote ekonaviṃśo'dhikāraḥjijñāsāṃ sphuṭayatica evārtheprāptanirmalaśivaikarūpā bhavantijñānakriyāśaktyātmatāṃ caparitaḥ samantādupāsate tanmayatvena sphurantiprāpayet |" ityādicchindyādityarthaḥsaṃgṛhītam, tat sarvaṃ kṣipramātmaniṣṭhaṃ kuryātmṛtoddhārādidīkṣyatvamucyatemantrakramāditīhatyamāntraparāmarśayuktyā rakṣetsūkṣmayogamudritaṃ kadācin mocayituṃ kṣamaḥdāruṇād doṣād mocako bhavatyevaityādikāruṇyādevānyasya kuryātyasmin deśe'thavā rāṣṭre nivasenmantrayogavityadīccheduttamāṃ siddhiṃ mokṣaṃ vā śāśvataṃ dhruvamanugrahārthaṃ martyānāṃ bhūpatīnāṃ kuṭumbināmyoginībhūtādyā nityaśuddhā rāgadveṣādihīnāḥājñaptā iti pūrvoktadurācāracchidraṇāya niyuktāḥanenetyatacchāstroddiṣṭena daityonmūlanātmanātattvavidaṃ iti śeṣa iti śivamnetrodyote viṃśo'dhikāraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃpracoditā ityuktam, kena prakāreṇa kartrā cetyarthaḥnistimitaṃ sāṃkhyapuruṣakalpamadvayaṃ brahma icchanti(śrīkiraṇā. ) itisiddhīrvitarantītyarthaḥāṇavatvādātmavanmalinā evaparapramātṛprameyātmatāṃ vinā kiṃcidapyupadyateyathāpraśnitaṃ sarvaṃ brūhiśaktimadavyatirekāt śāmbhavā apītyarthaḥpaśyantyādipadeṣviva vācyavācakakramaṃ jīvaḥparaṃ śuddho'dhvā, aparaṃ tvaśuddhaḥsarvatrānugrahādāvapratihataṃ śaktatvaṃ yeṣāmmahāsāmarasyaviśrāntyātmā āndo yasya, sa nirānandaḥjyeṣṭhādiśaktibhedenocyatesaṅkocābhāsavato'pi citprakāśātmatayaiva grāhakatvāduttamatvamsthitisaṃhṛtyupalakṣaṇaparamparameśa ityarthaḥ | sūkṣmatvādityavedyatvātbhāsayati, na tvanādisiddhaṃ tadityāśayaḥiti śivasvātantryamaparāmṛśyāṇvapekṣatvameva mantrāṇāmāhuḥbhūruktā, sṛjatītyanena tu śaktibhūmiḥityāha dhvanirūpo yadā sphoṭastvadṛṣṭācchivavigrahāt| atra ca nādānto'pyanupraviṣṭaḥmakārādakārāntamātmatattvātmatvena mantrasṛṣṭiruktāmātṛkājñānaśālinaḥnigrahānugrahakṛtaḥ śivadāśivahārakāśceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥnetrodyote ekaviṃśo'dhikāraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nirṇītaṃ caitat prāgevapraṇavoccāraṇānte viśramitavyamityarthaḥkṛtvā ālayaṃ catacchaktibṛṃhitatvādeva śāktāstanmayā evetyarthaḥmāntraṃ prameyamkāryeṇānābilīkṛtatvād vimalāḥ, anugrahapravaṇatvāt śubhāḥnirodhikā kalā hyetā sarvadevanirodhikāḥeṣātmakatvāt kuto'tyantanairmalyamśaktyādisamanāntānāmitisvaprakāśasvarūpaścana vindati yadā mantrī sṛṣṭisaṃhāravartmanītata ājñāṃ pālayetgamyate nīyate, gamirṇijanto'trauddyotātma samagraśakti śivayornetraṃ paraṃ tannumaḥno raktaṃ na ca naitadātma tadidaṃ netraṃ jayatyaiśvaramnetrodyote dvāviṃśo'dhikāraḥbhāsvaddyota sa doṣa eṣa viṣamasteṣāṃ dṛśastādṛśaḥśrīrāmādigurugrāmastathāntevāsino'pareakārṣurme tataḥ kiṃcididamudyotitaṃ mayāparādvaitāmṛtasphīto netrodyoto'yamutthitaḥparimalasarasānāṃ vyākarocchāstrametatasmābhirvimale hṛdambaratale niryantraṇaṃ sphī(sthī)yatejyotirnetraṃ jayati paramānandapūrṇaṃ tṛtīyam
